key.name: override-results-order
key.summary: Override default search results order to prioritize JetBrains
key.description: Boolean value indicating whether to override the default search results order to prioritize JetBrains. Requires disabling and re-enabling the extension to take effect.

key.name: select-first-result
key.summary: Select the first JetBrains result by default
key.description: Boolean value indicating whether the first JetBrains result is the default selection, so Enter opens it. Only applies when override-results-order is enabled. Requires disabling and re-enabling the extension to take effect.
